Name: Sony CrSDK Camera Plugin for N.I.N.A.
Author: isky

Descriptions.ShortDescription: Sony CrSDK 相机接入与共享控制 / Sony CrSDK camera integration and shared controls.
Descriptions.LongDescription:
## 中文

通过 Sony Camera Remote SDK 在 N.I.N.A. 中使用 Sony 相机：普通曝光、软件 Bulb、ISO/快门控制、JPEG 实时预览与 Bayer RAW 解码；Sony 扩展控制面板与标准相机入口共享同一连接。

**环境与兼容性**：Windows x64、N.I.N.A. 3.x（最低 3.2.0.9001）、Microsoft VC++ v14 x64 运行库。实机验证机型为 Sony A7 V（ILCE-7M5，固件 2.00）；其他机型尚未做实机验证，插件按机身实际返回的能力工作（ISO/快门候选、Bulb、RAW 格式、保存位置），遇到不支持的能力会明确拒绝而不是伪造。

**安装**：请自行取得并解压 Sony Camera Remote SDK 2.02.00 Windows x64。插件启动时只检测已配置的 SDK，不安装文件、不提权；只有在插件设置的 SDK 配置页确认后才会导入文件，写入受保护的共享适配器目录时 Windows 会请求管理员授权。公开包不包含 Sony SDK，也不安装驱动或系统运行库；SDK 配置不会连接相机。个人设置与 SDK 缓存独立保存，插件升级时保留。

**拍摄一致性**：ISO 与快门在跳过写入或提交曝光前都会刷新并回读；实际值与请求值不符时不触发快门，图像元数据使用已确认的实测参数。

[安装、升级与卸载](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.6/docs/INSTALL.md) · [使用说明](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.6/docs/USAGE.md) · [兼容性](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.6/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)

独立社区项目，与 Sony 或 N.I.N.A. 官方无隶属关系，由 isky 维护。

## English

Use Sony cameras in N.I.N.A. through Sony Camera Remote SDK: normal exposures, software Bulb, ISO/shutter control, JPEG LiveView and Bayer RAW decoding. The Sony control panel and the standard camera interface share one connection.

**Requirements and compatibility**: Windows x64, N.I.N.A. 3.x (minimum 3.2.0.9001) and the Microsoft VC++ v14 x64 runtime. Sony A7 V (ILCE-7M5, firmware 2.00) is the hardware-validated model; other models have not been validated on hardware and are driven by the capabilities each body actually reports (ISO/shutter candidates, Bulb, RAW format, save destination). Unsupported capabilities are refused explicitly rather than fabricated.

**Installation**: Obtain and extract Sony Camera Remote SDK 2.02.00 Windows x64 yourself. At startup the plugin only detects an already configured SDK and never installs files or elevates; files are imported only after you confirm on the SDK setup page in plugin settings, and writing a protected shared-adapter directory prompts for Windows administrator consent. No Sony SDK is bundled, and the plugin installs neither drivers nor system runtimes. SDK setup does not connect to a camera. User preferences and SDK caches are stored separately and preserved across plugin updates.

**Capture consistency**: ISO and shutter are refreshed and read back before a write is skipped or an exposure is submitted. A mismatch blocks the shutter, and image metadata uses the verified values.

[Installation, upgrade and removal](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.6/docs/INSTALL.md) · [Usage](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.6/docs/USAGE.md) · [Compatibility](https://github.com/isky-zh-l/Sony-CrSDK-Camera-Plugin-for-NINA/blob/v0.5.6/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md)
